description:
Dorion is an alternative Discord client aimed towards lower-spec or storage-sensitive PCs that supports themes, plugins, and more!


# Changes

• Add MacOS icons with liquid glass support
• Add MacOS overlay titlebar support
• Config is now handled in-memory
• Fix some popout-related issues
• Fix some external-open-related issues
• Fix some rsRPC crashes
• Fix some performance issues
• Fix custom plugins
